semantics.branchName: full refs/heads/name; preview action create|select with explicit author; apply includes target fields/previewId/requestId only, no author text
semantics.restore: preview source index|head, canonical sorted paths; apply target.action restore, source explicit, no author identity
semantics.target: Exact fields from GIT_BRANCH_RESTORE_TARGET_FIELDS; paths before/after actual raw bytes/digest/mode, beforeEntry original index or null, afterEntry chosen source entry or null, ident desired conversion. Metadata roles in publication order. No raw content/root/author in target.
semantics.treeOid: Verified target branch tree for select; verified current HEAD tree for create and restore. INDEX restore source authority is original index entries, not an invented commit/tree.
semantics.privateEntries: currentEntries complete original index; desiredEntries chosen target tree for select, HEAD tree for restore-head, original index for restore-index and create. Kernel independently parses raw graphs/index.
semantics.objects: Raw cryptographically verified object payload files objects/<oid>, rawBytes=bytes, install:false ALWAYS. No new original objects. Metadata/worktree proposals typed and hash-bound.
semantics.occupancyRows: Canonical byte-sorted [gitDirectory,HEADdigest,gitdirdigest|null,commondirdigest|null,lockeddigest|null]; full common primary plus every child; kernel must independently derive and verify actual records/listings.
semantics.identity: gitBranchRestoreIdentityDigest(author,timestamp) from [name,email,timestamp]; private artifact may retain explicit author under accepted residual, never journal/request apply.
semantics.dispatch: Both stage/publish require gitBranchRestoreTarget exact admission. No dispatch on reopen/unknown or duplicate.
semantics.receipt: kind git_branch_restore_applied with action/previewDigest/exact after path states/metadata digests/deterministic original-key role+path backups/digest. Empty registry delta.
semantics.backup: gitBranchRestoreExpectedBackups target + original epoch/op; nullable only originally absent targets; worktree backups live checked metadata root never sourceworktree/refs/logs.
semantics.sharedKernel: Same core adds branchRestore; prepared token and applied/aborted/unknown result; old facets unchanged.
